description: A built-in data descriptor that routes attribute reads, writes and deletes to getter, setter and deleter functions.
The private instance attribute (`_celsius`) where a property stores its value.
A property with only a getter. Assigning to it raises `AttributeError`.
A property whose value is derived on each read instead of stored, such as `kelvin` from `celsius`.
Callers use attribute syntax whether the value is stored or computed, so a plain attribute can become a property without changing callers.
